regimeSub: Warsh delivers first Fed hike in 3 years as sticky 3.7% CPI overrides 1.5% GDP slowdown.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh hiked 25bps to 3.75% on Sept 16, first increase since 2023 → 2Y surges to 4.67% (+28bps WoW), signals more tightening ahead despite growth slump
Aug retail sales +1.2% MoM beat estimates → validates Warsh's confidence in consumer resilience but cements hawkish path as demand sustains inflation pressure
BOK signals additional 2026 hike following Fed pivot → KRW weakens to 1379 vs 1365 yesterday as EM central banks forced to match Fed tightening cycle
Brent holds $105.76 as Houthi Red Sea disruptions persist despite June Iran ceasefire → energy pass-through keeps headline CPI elevated at 3.7%, constraining Fed optionality

signalNotes.note: Policy at 3.75% vs 3.7% CPI yields near-zero real rate; Warsh needs more hikes to get meaningfully restrictive

headline: Warsh executes first Fed hike in three years to 3.75%, 10Y breaches 5.0% as stagflation grip tightens with 3.7% CPI meeting 1.5% GDP.
